coordinate_system.advanced_flow_convention: xcℓ,ycℓ and Ixℓ,Iyℓ,Ixyℓ are median-wall area centroid/inertias; unit-force q gradients and torque use those centroidal coordinates. Sectorial warping uses the shear-center pole. Offsets use the gross centroid. Normalized diagnostic wall data are scaled by normalization_length_mm; returned properties and formula dimensions are physical mm powers.
coordinate_system.component_convention: Nonoverlapping material rectangles; x_i,y_i in stored components are lower-left corners, centroid x_i+b_i/2,y_i+h_i/2; A_i=b_i*h_i and intrinsic product inertia=0. Principal u follows major-inertia axis, v is its counterclockwise perpendicular; X=x-xbar,Y=y-ybar. Indeterminate principal bases use reference u=X,v=Y, explicitly nonunique.
coordinate_system.mechanical_moment_convention: Normal stress tensile positive; generalized Mx=integral(Y*sigma)dA and My=integral(X*sigma)dA. Other physical/member moment sign conventions require an explicit adapter.
